content:
nina_support: Hey @leo_eng — getting a report from a customer (acct 98765) that the Support Console shows 'Grant queued' and a success toast but their credit balance is unchanged. I clicked 'Grant trial credits' twice for them just to be sure.
leo_eng: thanks. do you have the request id / the UI log? also which environment (prod/us-east)?
nina_support: prod/us-east. UI request id: req=abc123def. I grabbed server logs from the console:
```
INFO support-console request=req=abc123def user=svc-support action=grant payload={customer:98765,amount:50}
DEBUG support-api -> backoffice POST /grants/commit req=req=abc123def status=404 body="not_found: grant_record"
INFO support-console toast="Grant queued" req=req=abc123def
```
leo_eng: hmm POST /grants/commit returning 404 is odd (should be 200 or 202). can you paste the full backoffice log around the time? any 401s?
nina_support: pasted the excerpt above; nothing obvious in UI. I also saw a separate row in the audit: grant_attempt with tombstone_id=null. no error message to user.
infra-bot: backoffice-deploy prod/us-east finished rolling update at 2026-02-02T17:01:10Z; image: backoffice:v3.4.1
sam_ops: tagging in — I'm seeing spikes of 401s from support-console service account in backoffice logs around 17:00:40-17:02:00. sample: "error=unauthorized service=backoffice endpoint=/grants/commit token=svc-support"
leo_eng: can you paste a 401 log line? also confirm whether the support-console is using the short-lived token or a cluster secret.
sam_ops: here you go:
```
ERROR backoffice auth failed endpoint=/grants/commit grant_id=none reason="token invalid" client_id=svc-support trace=tx-77b
WARN backoffice retrying auth for client=svc-support attempt=3
ERROR backoffice final failure endpoint=/grants/commit status=401
```
leo_eng: so two things: 401s indicate an auth token issue; 404 probably comes from backoffice code that tries to validate idempotency tombstone after auth failure and returns not_found. i suspect a race when auth fails and tombstone cleanup runs.
leo_eng: repro steps for me: 1) use support-console service token (I recreated locally) 2) curl POST to /grants/commit with payload {customer:98765,amount:50,idempotency_key:req-abc123} 3) observe 401 intermittently on prod shard. sample curl below:
```
curl -X POST https://backoffice.prod.redwood/internals/grants/commit \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SUPPORT_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: req-abc123" \
  -d '{"customer":98765,"amount":50}' -v
```
leo_eng: immediate workaround: use admin-cli to create grant (admin-cli grants create --acct 98765 --amount 50) or run the backoffice one-off repair job that applies pending grant records.
maria_cs: applied manual grant for customer 98765 via admin-cli; confirmed they now see +50 credits. informed customer and issued apology.
nina_support: can you confirm ETA for a fix? I have 2 other open tickets where customers hit same issue.
sam_ops: root cause appears to be token rotation job that rotated the service principal's token but failed to update the k8s secret before the backoffice pods started handling requests. result: intermittent 401s during rollout window. also found a small bug where, on auth failure, the commit handler returns a tombstone lookup that surfaces as 404 to the caller.
leo_eng: planned fix: 1) hotfix in backoffice to return 5xx on auth errors rather than 404 for missing tombstone (so UI will retry instead of showing success), 2) add startup check in backoffice to fail pod readiness if auth to authz service fails, 3) coord with infra to fix token rotation to be atomic. I'll open a JIRA and assign.
leo_eng: JIRA: INFRA-4521 (backoffice: grant commit auth/404 handling) — I'll link once created.
infra-bot: created incident draft: incident/2026-02-02-grants-auth-rotation
maria_cs: customer notified and credits restored. leaving note on ticket.
nina_support: thanks all. adding follow-up to the support runbook: if UI shows success but customer unchanged -> check backoffice /grants/commit 401/404 window and escalate to sam_ops.
leo_eng: thanks @nina_support. will post postmortem and remediation steps once INFRA-4521 is live. :thumbsup:")
